narr: Moist southeast flow fueled thunderstorms over southeast California. Several storms produced flash flooding, and a few produced severe weather.
ev: Six inches of water flowed through the intersection of Prescott Ave and Del Mar St.
Southbound Interstate 15 was flooded near Nipton Road, and closed to the Nevada state line. One person was injured (indirect) in a crash on the wet highway before it was closed.
Highway 127 was flooded at Baker Blvd.
Highway 127 was closed between mile markers 15 and 21.
Water and mud covered Goffs Road in multiple locations.
The intersection of Yucca Mesa Rd and Aberdeen Dr was flooded.
